workspace.title: Certification agreements
workspace.description: Send the certification agreement, collect e-signatures and keep every version.
workspace.termsDescription: Your agreement template, its variables and the audit plan gate.

common.loadError: The agreements could not be loaded. Try again.

next.sent: Waiting for the client to sign

register.title: Certification agreements
register.subtitle: The legally enforceable agreement with each client (ISO/IEC 17021-1 clause 5.1.2): drafted when the client accepts the offer, signed electronically by both parties.
register.emptyHint: An agreement is drafted automatically when a client accepts an offer. You can also generate one for any client.
register.footnote: Stage 1, Stage 2 and recertification plans can be sent only when the client's agreement is active. Change this rule in Agreement terms.

generate.title: Generate agreement
generate.description: The draft uses your agreement terms and the client's latest accepted offer. You can edit it before sending.

detail.draftHint: This is a draft. Check the values, then send it to the client for signature.

toast.countersigned: Agreement countersigned. It is now active.
toast.refreshed: The draft now uses your latest agreement terms.
toast.signed: Thank you. The agreement is signed and sent to the certification body.

edit.title: Edit agreement values
edit.description: These values fill the variables of the agreement text. Changes apply to this draft only.

terminate.title: Terminate {{reference}}
terminate.description: Termination cannot be undone. If the client received the agreement, they are notified.

amend.title: Amend {{reference}}
amend.description: An amendment is a new version of the agreement. When both parties sign it, it replaces the current version.

integrity.title: Document integrity
integrity.ok: The text matches the fingerprint sealed when it was sent.
integrity.failed: The stored text does not match its sealed fingerprint. Do not rely on this copy and contact iCASCO support.
integrity.draft: Draft: the fingerprint is sealed when you send the agreement.
integrity.draftHash: SHA-256 fingerprint of the current draft

sign.description: You are signing {{reference}}. Your signature applies to the text in both languages.
sign.name: Full name
sign.consent: I have read the agreement and agree to sign it electronically. My name, title, signature, date and time, IP address and device are recorded with it.
sign.codeHint: We email you a 6 digit code. It is valid for 10 minutes and you have 5 attempts.
sign.codeSent: Code sent to {{to}}. It is valid for 10 minutes.
sign.demoCode: Preview mode: no email is sent. Your code is

gate.blockTitle: This plan cannot be sent yet
gate.body: Stage 1, Stage 2 and recertification audits need an active certification agreement with the client (signed by the client and countersigned by you).

errors.AGREEMENT_REQUIRED: This client has no active certification agreement. Send the agreement and have it signed before sending a Stage 1, Stage 2 or recertification plan.
errors.AGREEMENT_INVALID_STATUS: This action is not available for the agreement in its current status. Refresh the page.
errors.SIGNING_ORDER: The client signs first. You can countersign once the client has signed.
errors.OTP_INVALID: The code is not correct. Attempts left: {{attemptsLeft}}.
errors.OTP_EXPIRED: The code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.OTP_LOCKED: Too many wrong codes. Request a new code.
errors.OTP_RATE_LIMIT: A code was sent less than a minute ago. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
errors.DOCUMENT_CHANGED: The agreement changed after you opened it. Reload the page and review it again.
errors.DOCUMENT_INTEGRITY_FAILED: The agreement text no longer matches its sealed fingerprint, so it cannot be signed. Contact the certification body.
errors.REMINDER_RATE_LIMIT: A reminder was already sent in the last 24 hours.
errors.AMENDMENT_IN_PROGRESS: An amendment of this agreement is already in progress. Finish or terminate it first.
errors.UNKNOWN_VARIABLE: The text uses variables that do not exist: {{variables}}.
errors.NO_EMAIL: Your account has no email address to receive the signing code.

terms.title: Agreement terms
terms.subtitle: The certification agreement your clients sign: bilingual sections with variables, filled for each client.
terms.draftNoticeTitle: Default text: draft for the product owner's review
terms.draftNotice: The default text covers the obligations of ISO/IEC 17021-1 clause 5.1.2 in our own words. Have it reviewed by your legal adviser and adapt it to your rules before using it with clients.
terms.usingDefault: You are using the default text. Saving creates your own version.
terms.gateHint: What happens when a Stage 1, Stage 2 or recertification plan is sent and the client has no active agreement.

gate.blockHint: The plan cannot be sent until the agreement is active.
gate.warnHint: The plan is sent and a warning is shown.

terms.variablesHint: Click a variable to insert it where your cursor is. Each agreement fills it with the client's values.
terms.copied: {{token}} copied. Paste it into the text.
terms.saved: Agreement terms saved. New agreements use this version.
terms.resetHint: Your sections are replaced by the default text. The audit plan gate setting is kept. Existing agreements do not change.

portal.title: Agreements
portal.subtitle: Certification agreements from your certification body: review, sign and download.
portal.emptyHint: Your certification body sends the agreement after you accept the offer. It appears here for your signature.
portal.signHint: Read the agreement in English or Arabic, then sign it. We email you a code to confirm your signature.
portal.waitingCab: You signed this agreement. It becomes active when the certification body countersigns it.
portal.terminated: The certification body terminated this agreement. Reason: {{reason}}

pdf.notSigned: Not yet signed by both parties
pdf.verifyNote: Each signature was confirmed with a one-time code sent by email. Any change to the text changes its SHA-256 fingerprint.

agreement_drafted.title: Agreement {{ref}} drafted
agreement_drafted.body: The certification agreement for {{client}} is ready. Review it and send it for signature.

agreement_signed_by_client.title: Agreement {{ref}} signed by the client
agreement_signed_by_client.body: {{client}} signed the certification agreement. Countersign it to make it active.

agreement_to_sign.title: Agreement {{ref}} to sign
agreement_to_sign.body: Review the certification agreement and sign it electronically.

agreement_active.title: Agreement {{ref}} is active
agreement_active.body: Both parties have signed the certification agreement. Download the signed copy.

agreement_terminated.title: Agreement {{ref}} terminated
agreement_terminated.body: The certification body terminated the certification agreement.
